title: Yoisaki Kanade — Unformed Sound〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same. I'm ready to start working whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But is there anything we can do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, right.
The next song will be the one based on what Yuki told us about her family in SEKAI earlier, yeah?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, what should we do while we wait for K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I have other demos ready, so I'd appreciate it if you could all start working on those.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Let's see... Oh, here they are.
I'll send them over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, K, I can't wait to hear how your song captures the warm memories Yuki has of her family.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Same. Still, warmth...
You could tackle that from a lot of different angles.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. Feelings and stuff are one thing, but plenty of physical objects are also warm♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For example, the sense of relaxation that overcomes you when you dip into a warm bath.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess that also goes for those heated eyemasks that help with eye fatigue. I really like how warm and cozy they feel.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's like being gently wrapped in a blanket, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Can either of you come up with examples of when you feel that kind of warmth, K, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Does this have anything to do with composing?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, c'mon. We did just upload a new song today. Why not relax a bit by having a chat?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, this could lead to your next great idea♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When do I feel that sort of warmth...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I suppose when we're having a meal together, or drinking tea...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Which involves physically warm food or drinks, yes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In that case, what sort of warmth do you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<What sort of warmth...?
When you phrase it that way, I don't really know...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let's put it to the test!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. I also fixed myself a cup.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why not? Maybe I just wanted to feel included.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, we did just pour these cups.
They're hot more than warm, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Why don't we wait until they're just the right temperature?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me. Do you two know what “just the right temperature” is?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yuki told me the other day.
Let's see... For warm drinks, the range is between sixty and seventy-degrees Celsius. For cold drinks, it's between five and eleven, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's right. Apparently, those are the temperatures in which we think those drinks are the most delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, really?! Also, what led to you two talking about something like that?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How did we end up on that subject...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think we were originally talking about how consuming things which are too hot or too cold isn't good for your digestive system...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <They should be the right temperature now, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think so. Why don't we try taking a sip?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, before you do, why don't you try feeling how warm your cup is first?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, me too! Ow! Oww!
Mine's still piping hot...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're kidding, right? It's been a while since we poured our tea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's still super hot. That's the truth.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You were right, Yuki. Mine's still fairly warm too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll try taking a sip now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What was that, Amia...?
You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, I'm not! This really is molten hot!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Seriously...? Anyway, Yuki, K, what are your thoughts?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, and I can feel the warmth coursing through my body...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd say this is more soothing than gentle.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, Mizuki was right. Taking a break was a good idea.)
